test_policy: Do not tune methods, prompts, or labels after viewing test results. Create a new evaluation version for further tuning.
primary_metric: all required supporting records in the first ten candidates
no_evidence_metric: number of questions with returned candidates; not an answer or abstention score
expected_modes: evaluation labels only; not supplied to models and not predicted by this retrieval experiment
time_filters: Two questions receive a broad September window. Other questions have no time filter.
development_change: After development run 1, model-generated queries use OR matching instead of AND matching. The planner prompt is unchanged.
